messages:
Molly T.: Orchid Thera INV-9043 charge failed yesterday — gateway shows 'insufficient_funds' then 'authorization_declined (3DS required)'. Any manual retry plan?

Rajiv K.: Auto-retries ran twice, third attempt queued for 2024-07-05 09:00 PDT. No AVS mismatch flagged. Gateway code: 402 / 3DS_REQUIRED.

BillingBot: Auto-retry status: attempts=2, next_attempt=2024-07-05T16:00:00Z. Flag=manual_review if declines again.

Samir P.: Tried server-side resubmit, triggered a 3DS flow — corporate p-cards are blocking it. Customer told Emma they can do ACH or wire instead. Emma, can you share bank details?

Emma L.: Their AP replied; they prefer wire and asked for our wire template + beneficiary address. They pasted a redacted copy of their remit (asked me to DM full account details):

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Beneficiary Address: 540 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94107
Bank: First Valley Bank
Routing: 021000021
Account (redacted): ****6789
Ref: INV-9043 / Orchid Thera
```

Emma L.: I'll DM the full account number via secure channel (per finance policy).

Rajiv K.: Can we approve waiving the $75 late fee and allow a one-time manual retry only after we confirm wired funds? Need a quick sign-off to proceed so I can pause auto-retries.

Molly T.: Approved — waive the $75 late fee and hold off auto-retries. Manual retry only after settlement clears. Emma, please send the wire template and include the invoice reference. :+1: 

Samir P.: I'll draft the payment instructions and email ops@orchidthera.com with the wire details and reference INV-9043. I'll also mark the invoice pending-wire in the ledger and suspend automatic retries.

Emma L.: Sent wire template and confirmation request. AP confirmed they will initiate the wire today and will share the bank send receipt. I asked them to CC finance@redwood.com once done.

Molly T.: Perfect. Samir, when funds settle, reconcile and record settlement in the accounting system, then change invoice status to paid and close. Thanks everyone. :tada:
